title: Personnel of Lucky Millinder's band
summary: He lists the band members around 1941, including Bill Doggett, Trevor Bacon, George Duvivier and Tab Smith.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Can you think of any other things like on those tours that -- who were some of the guys in that band, Panama? You said it was you and Bill Dogett, of course.

Well, there was Bill Dogett on piano, Trevor Bacon was playing guitar, and vocalist; George Duvivier was the base, Chiefie Scott was lead trumpet player, Archie Johnson, Nelson Bryant played the high notes; George Stevenson, Joe Britton and Don Cole was the trombones. Saxaphones were Tab Smith, George James, Dave Young, Pazusa and Ernest Purce. And then myself on drums.
About what year was this, Panama?
